title.en: Major Agreements and concepts under WTO (World Trade Organization)
title.hi: Major Agreements and concepts under WTO (World Trade Organization)

definition.en: The World Trade Organization (WTO) is a global international organization that deals with the rules of trade between nations, focusing on reducing trade barriers and ensuring fair competition.
definition.hi: The World Trade Organization (WTO) is a global international organization that deals with the rules of trade between nations, focusing on reducing trade barriers and ensuring fair competition.

importanceInUpsc.en: This topic is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it directly impacts India's agricultural policies, food security, and international trade negotiations. Understanding WTO agreements like the Agreement on Agriculture (AoA) is essential for analyzing India's stance on subsidies and public stockholding.
